original.target_description: Unresolved: description names income–WTP relationship, study label spans 1b–1c; assigned p. 3 prints context × income interactions, not an explicitly identified income main-effect test.

notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: full Research Article, Scarcity Frames Value, Anuj K. Shah, Eldar Shafir, and Sendhil Mullainathan, Psychological Science 2015, 26(4), 402–412, DOI 10.1177/0956797614563958. Text contains main article through references, not supplemental material. No PDF was supplied. Target correspondence remains unresolved. The description is the relationship between income and willingness to pay, whereas the printed partial eta-squared candidates concern income × context interactions: Study 1b ηp2 = .07, F(1,145) = 11.18, p < .01 (PDF p. 3); Study 1c ηp2 = .01, F(1,574) = 5.68, p < .05 (PDF p. 5). Study 1b continuous-income interaction is β = 2.27 and Study 1c is β = 1.65, also not an identified income main effect. Table 1 supplies candidate model sample sizes 149 (1b) and 578 (1c); these are candidate evidence only and are not assigned to the unresolved target. No target was inferred from row order or numerical similarity. Unassigned fields and replication/success are placeholders only.
